arguments.sql: SELECT ml.city AS city, ml.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE f.is_fraud = 1 GROUP BY ml.city, ml.state ORDER BY fraud_count DESC, ml.city ASC, ml.state ASC
arguments.explanation: Counts labelled fraud transactions by merchant city and state, most frequent first.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; only labelled transactions are counted.
City and state come from the transaction's merchant location (merchant_location_id).
Online transactions (city 'ONLINE', no state) appear as their own group rather than a real city.
